comments: We were greeted at the agreed upon time and Deiter was very helpful in acquainting us with the neighborhood and with the flat.  The neighborhood was great.  Right near the tram, wonderful bakery next door, restaurants and shops nearby. The flat was accurately described  and spacious.  Kitchen was in excellent order.  All plates and cutlery were clean and serviceable.

Ramfis' place was fabulous. The location was perfect as it was walking distance to nearby attractions and right by a tram stop for anything further a field.
The place itself was comfortable and so warm! The rooms, bathroom and kitchen were all great.
Overall I would absolutely recommend. Thank you Ramfis!!!

Alke's apartment is great, so spacious and in a really good area with easy walks to tram and train stations into the city. We enjoyed using it as a base whilst we stayed the weekend in Berlin. The facilities are really good, there is a great shower and bath and the kitchen has everything you need. There is a park down the road and a restaurant on the street below and local shops close by. We loved the design and style of the rooms with big art works on the walls. We had a nice time there, thanks Alke!!

We enjoyed our stay in Henrik's apartment very much. It was very tidy and it has a cosy feeling. It was equipped with everything one could need.
Its location is perfect, with walking distance to a lot of sights if you visit as a tourist. The neighbourhood is also very nice and the apartment was actually very quiet.
We can recommend this to anyone visiting Berlin!

The apartment was nice and spacious. Also location was good and there were many good restaurants nearby. Only things we didn’t like was that apartment was bit dusty and floors very squeaky. But definitely would recommend it.

Henrik and Sven were fantastic! We enjoyed the flat and them very much. The flat was a great little place and the location was good and in a quiet neighborhood. Their communication was awesome and they held our bags so we cold check out at a later time. The place is old but that was what made it so special and very nice to stay in!! We highly recommend staying here. They are truly great!

We had a lovely stay at this airy and spacious Prenzlauerberg flat. The neighborhood cannot be beat. Close to great restaurants, shops, and near tram and rail stations. The third floor walk-up is worth it as you are high up in the trees. Convenient to corner market for staples. Beds are comfy. Yoga mats and kids toys provided! Very kind and helpful hosts. Everything we needed was there.
We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend highly!!
Very clean and super nice! The place is close frome bus and s-bahn all the comforts are close!! Perfect for young and couples!! The host is kindly I suggest this place!!!
We were very well received by Ute, she was very nice and helpful, she gave us good recommendations. The place is well furnished with a very central location.
This was a last min booking after missing a flight, I was able to book this very fast which was a great help. Nice apartment with a kitchen including oven. Very good!

Kirsten was a great host and her apartment was so cute! We loved the area and how walkable the place was to everything - Markthalle Neun is a few steps away! Only recommendation is to read the note she leaves for guests to figure out the shower/hot water situation. Great stay nonetheless!

Easy check-in and check-out.
Slight smell of smoke in the bedroom, but this could be from the bar below.

Arzu and tom's place in Berlin was great. It is very close to berlin's well connected metro and has plenty of shops within walking distance for shopping, food and more. It has a nice kitchen and bathroom, a bedroom and a living room (which also has a bed) with a balcony. I stayed with just 1 friend and there was more than enough space.
Tom is an excellent host, he gave us recommendations for Berlin, helped us do our washing and was very easy to communicate with. They live on the floor above which was very convenient for communication but they also gave us good privacy.
I would love to return to this apartment if I go back to Berlin!

Very comfortable apartment in a great area.  Kitchen well equipped and washer/dryer very good.  Host was very responsive and dealt with a minor issue (my mistake!) immediately.  A great place to stay.

The apartment is in the very attractive Bergmannkiez - "Bergmann neighbourhood". It is my favourite part of Berlin. So, the location is great. 50 minutes to the airport by public transport in a very easy way. U7 and X71
It was clean, the design is good and the bed was comfortable.
The apartment is a par Terre, which means it is partially basement and the windows are high. The bathroom is very small, but practical and works fine. The heating is good and in the bedroom you do not hear the street.
Verda's place is as advertised. Clean and located in a great area. We enjoyed our stay.

Our first impression of Roi's place was lovely,
The apartment was immaculate from top to bottom and it had a welcoming touch to it. Overall, it was totally what we had expected. Anything we needed he was on the case and did his best to make our day enjoyable! Thank you Roi!

Very nice apartment in a nice and quiet area but still close to public transportation, supermarkets and a nice park nearby. Rémi Martin was a very nice host and asked several times during our stay if everything was okay and if we needed anything. We recommend the apartment as well as Rémi Martin as a host.

A nice, simple and homely stay and great value for money. The room and bathroom were very clean. I did not spend much time with Alessandro in person, but his communication was great and check in/check-out was easy. Well connected location.

Great spacious apartment, ideal for big families or groups of friends. The apartment is equipped with modern kitchen and kitchen appliances, washing machine. All bedsheets and towels are provided. We enjoyed our stay a lot.
Very nice place for a family. Clean and nice apartment and good playgrounds near by. Perfect place for some good days in Berlin.
It was a warm and nice place .And you could reach U2 and S 3/5/7/9 station here and about 15 -20 mins to get the Berlin city cube/ exhibition by S3/9.   A lot of shops nearby. Very convenient.
Zito and Zohra are excellent persons, very kind, they recommend you lot of activities in Berlin to use the room just to sleep.

Excellent stay in Berlin. Zito and Zohra are great, very nice welcome although I could only see Zohra.
However Zito give precious advices to discover Berlin and activities by Airbnb message. The appartment is conform to the ad. I recommend !!
Thank you Zito and Zohra !!

Great location in Neukolln, great neighbourhood with a few nice bars right around the corner. Close to the metro too, only 30 mins to the airport. Rainer is a very responsive host who made it all so easy for us to check in and check out. Clean.

Rainer was really responsive and helpful, the apartment itself was good and had everything we needed the only downside were the stairs but we knew about that before hand! Got slightly easier as we got used to it haha. Lovely wine bar round the corner and easy public transport.

Spaceious loft in the middle of a bubbly quarter of Berlin. Crowdy area but quietly located loft (we love that!). Great restaurants of all flavour and cultures at walking distance. Free parking in the area of the loft. Close to two metro-stations. City-life as we like it!

Check in was easy and we were closer to public transport which made exploring other areas of Berlin a breeze.  Apartment was on ground floor with Windows directly on the street but the frosted glass and blackout curtains gave us enough privacy for our comfort.
Convenient location and ok value for money, good for group with up to 4 sleeping places but not much beyond that

We travelled with children and stayed four nights. The area is great for hanging out with the family or to have an evening drink without the kids. Good connections with U-bahn and metro. Several grocery stores within walking distance.
The apartment is very spacious, with three large bedrooms and a comfortable and well equipped kitchen and dining place. Werner is a reliable and accommodating host, providing all necessary information as well as tips and recommendations for your visit.
We highly recommend a stay in Prenzlauerberg and this apartment.

Great stay in Berlin! The Loft is cozy and really interesting furniture, all in industrial style! The bed is very comfortable and all you need for a pleasant stay is in the Loft! Host was friendly and gave all necessary information! Highly recommandable
What a gorgeous gorgeous place! Superbly located it had everything we needed and was done up so beautifully. We had an absolutely wonderful time. Will be back!
The room is large and comfortable. The apartment is near the center of the city and close to public transport. It was just for one night, in general everything was fine!

Sören is the perfect host; punctual, welcoming, warm, knowledgeable, and generous! He met us at the apartment, told us everything we needed to know and answered a few of our questions about Berlin in great detail.
The apartment itself was spotlessly clean and well furnished with almost anything you could need. The flat is great for large groups, with 2 bathrooms and 2 kitchens, it's easy for everyone to get ready in the morning. Just 2 minutes from the S-Bahn station and around 3 minutes from the underground, it's also in a great location for being able to travel around the city. There are plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants nearby.
I would cannot recommend Sören's place enough; we will definitely be staying with him again should we return to Berlin.
Great place to stay, super close to everything and the restaurants near are delicious. So much attention for detail. You will feel at home in no time. Just be ready for lots of stairs

If I could give Robert's place 6 stars, I would. We've stayed in nearly 40 Airbnbs over the years, and this was the best! He is clear about the stairs, so you will get some exercise coming home at night, but this balances well with all the excellent food nearby, so it allows you to burn some of it off. The bed is incredibly comfortable, and the flat itself is truly a work of art. We stayed in the room on the 4th floor, which has its own interest (so a little fewer stairs) and the most amazing shower room. When next in Berlin, we'll definitely come back to Robert's place!

An elegant pad in a neighbourhood close to the city. The building in which it is situated is safe, family friendly and has great gardens to enjoy...and is very stylish. Great communication also and fully recommend this great apartment

Flat is good.
Location might me better but connection is good and you can reach any part of the city easily.
Babette's place was very spacious and was able to accommodate all 4 travelers in our party comfortably. Really lucky to have stayed here!
Perfect room for a city visit. The apartment was very clean and Kathrin was very kind and willing to help!

Myself, my husband, and our 2 kids (3+7) went with friends with 1 kid (6).
The apartment was perfect. Just the right size for all of us and with everything we needed. It was lovely and quiet with a lovely safe outside courtyard. We would definitely recommend the apartment and wouldn’t hesitate to book again if coming back to Berlin.
Thank you David, Stephan and Inge.

The apartment looks way better in reality. Werner was the best host we’ve had so far and I bet that every guest he’s had simply loved him. Thank you very much for your hospitality and kindness, Werner! We really loved staying at your place, everything was simply amazing!

This rental was exactly as described, and exactly what we needed for a larger group. Convenient to public transit, and in a pleasant neighborhood with lots to do, this will be a great jumping off point for your trip to Berlin. The rental is also well equipped with a kitchen and whatever amenities you might need for your stay, as well as a wonderfully proactive and responsive host.
Everything was amazing. The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Thanks, Raissa and Jonathan! I really hope to return again and again.

The apartment was very nice, very clean, well designed, the hosts thought of every detail and because of that we felt very comfortable like we are at our home. The hosts were very friendly and available, the check in and out was easy. I highly recommend this apartment .

Fabulous, well-equipped flat in a brilliant location. The apartment was so comfortable it was sometimes hard to leave it and the balcony overlooking the street - but when we did, it was so quick and easy to go shopping, eat out or just take the U-Bahn to get anywhere in the city! I've been to Berlin many times and stayed in various areas, but this was one of the best, so I hope we will come back another time. As a first AirBnB experience it was also great having the friendly key-holder next door to answer any questions. Thank you very much, Hannah.
Doro was an incredible host, very sweet, attentive and willing to help. She made sure in every detail that we were comfortable and we did felt like home!We hope to cross paths agains

A stylish apartment in a nice neighborhood. Grocery store, pharmacy, coffee shops all very close by. We’ve stayed as a group of 4, easily fit and had space. Had no problems from check in to check out thanks to Stephanie.
We really enjoyed our stay at Frank's appartment, it is well connected with the public transport, close to great green areas and calm neighbourhood.

Simon was a helpful and friendly host. The flat was beautiful and in a perfect location! It had all the required amenities plus a lovely garden to enjoy the summer weather. It's set back from the street so it feels very private and doesn't get the street noise. It's a wonderful flat in a very cool city and I would highly recommend it to anyone travelling through Berlin!

Great location in a cool, diverse & comfortable neighborhood.  The apartment was clean and functional. The central location and proximity to the U-Bahn made getting around the city easy.  There’s also a bike rental shop a block away.  I‘d  definitely stay here again.

Accommodation is in a quiet district with a good connection to the center of Berlin (the bus to the S-bahn station is approximately 200 m away, goes every 10-15 min). The room is perfectly clean. The beds are convenient. Nice clean bathroom and toilet.
Jürgen is a great and welcoming host, open and ready to help. He shared with us his own kitchen! We felt like at home.
Lovely apartment! Great and attentive host! Kitchen was well supplied with all the necessary appliances. Very clean! Close to public transport and a large mall & supermarket two blocks away.

Perfect place with U subway nearby, nice for walking around and exploring city.
Apartment itself is a part of hotel or hostel, where there is one common corridor with 7 or 8 mini apartments. It's clean and nice inside. Everything you need for the few days stay is available.
What can be better:
- Bathroom seems a bit too small with a lack of racks and shower gel / soap. It would be nice there to have some towel for feet to step on a dry stuff instead of wet floor.
- Entrance is absolutely roaming and phone dependent. If your phone is uncharged, stolen of you don't have roaming, you can't get inside. It would be valuable to simplify the entrance procedure.
- The distance between a bed and a ceiling is too small. It's difficult not to hit your head.

Host is very helpful and responds quickly if there is any problem they will help you with everthing. Beautiful premises, great for group accommodation.  Everything was great.  Calm and quiet surroundings.  I highly recommend.

The apartment was great, the location a nice 20 minute walk to the S bahn, less for the U. Plenty of amenities nearby.
The coffee machine is a Tassimo so needs specific pods.
Massive amounts of bed space, easily sleep 6.
It was an amazing apartment, great value and very modern, in an amazing location so close to the best pubs and clubs in Berlin. Highly recommend

We had a great time, the home of Julius and Tanja made our stay in Berlin really great. After being out in the city their house feels like a oasis of trancuility in a intensive city like Berlin. Well located in moabit. This side of Berlin is not so touristic and has easy going vibes. Parks all around and good food not far away. We can recommand your stay in their home.
The apartment is in a wonderful neighbourhood with excellent public transport links to tourist sights in the city centre and the airport
It was like being in a hotel but with the privacy and check in of an apartment. We will return for the ease of check in, great amenities, and the bed was so comfortable!
Perfect location, very close to a supermarket and easy to go to the main street by walk. Spacious and clean

Such a lovely Airbnb! Beautiful views and natural light in the apartment and in the perfect location - easy to get everywhere without the noise of being in the main area. There’s a lovely roof for coffee and views of the city accessible to guests. Matthew was easy to reach when needed. Would recommend staying here!

The accommodation was very well furnished, spacious and clean. Susan responded quickly to messages and was extremely helpful.
In the evening it was unfortunately noisy because there is a restaurant under the apartment.
Overall, I can recommend the accommodation for everyone who wants to explore various places to eat and drink, enjoy nightlife but also nice walks in the evening, or searches for somewhere to stay during a work trip.

We felt at home at Susan‘s wonderful and beautiful place right away! As we had to change our travel plans on very short notice, we were very glad that Susan replied quickly and was very helpful. The place looked just as shown on the photos and the location right in the middle of Berlin is just great. We definately want to stay there again!

Kevin’s place was fantastic. We felt very comfortable. It was comfortably big enough for the two of us and our belongings. It was in a good location to two different train stations and was easy to find.  Having a kitchen and fridge was very helpful too
Great location, very clean, easy self-check-in, comfortable bed & linens, hosts were super responsive - even last min, and had everything you need for a short comfortable enjoying stay.

We loved Tanja’s apartment. The location was fantastic. The apartment is  very centrally located and on a main road but inside the apartment is very quiet as it faces away from the road and toward a park to the rear. There are some great restaurants nearby, we would recommend Pirouette! And very near to a few u bahn stations and tram stations for visiting other areas.

A cute little place with good train links to central Berlin.
Nice neighborhood .
Thomas was so accommodating and really nice.

I would absolutely stay here again (and likely will). Exactly what one needs for a week in Berlin. the bed is comfortable, the kitchen has all you need, the shower is hot and the place is close to the metro. Daniela is a great host and super friendly.

Dietrich’s place was just as described, in a quiet neighborhood, close to public transportation and many good cafes and restaurants. Parking in the area was very easy as well, I was able to leave my car in the spot nearby the whole time with no issue. A cozy place for a weekend stay in Berlin, would come again.

This is a really stylish and relaxing apartment to stay at! We really loved the soft bed/sleeping nook area, and the apartment is cozy but makes great use of the space. There's also a beautiful park across the street, and easy + free street parking in the area, which is great if you're driving. There are also places to eat in the neighborhood - about a 10 - 15 minute walk away. Though we were only there for a night, we had a nice and comfortable stay here and would definitely come back again for our next trip to Berlin!
The accomodation was great. We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment has great access to public transport. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Berlin.

Mina’s place was great, about an hour 15 minute walk into the city centre but still in a lovely area. The apartment we had everything we needed and the outdoor area is lovely, would definitely stay again :)

Mina was very responsive and understanding.I stayed here for Boston Marathon weekend.The place have a calm and relaxed vibe.Great night sleep.
Being only 2 mins from the UG train station made it ideal to explore different parts of the city.
Highly recommend and would definitely recommend
Quick shout to Rumi was very helpful made check in and check out seamless
Thanks Mina
Probably the most impressive AirBnB I've ever been to in this price range! Perfect apt. with a gym, sauna and pool on premise, I will definitely return when I'm in Berlin again!
She is so kind and helpful. House is big and clean the bad also very comfortable 10/10
Super home in centre of berlin, the neighborhood it’s really cool. Polina was super available to our request :)
the location was brilliant with plenty of public transport to get you to the heart of Berlin. it's also only a short walk to the river or the plaza. the price was worth it for the location.
Amazing cozy place in the heart of Kreuzberg. Felt at home from the first moment. Ulf and Caroline are pleasant and very responsive hosts.
Comfortable,  well located, clean and had all the necessary amenities. Great value from money, I will definitely stay again!

Fab place to stay in a quiet neighborhood of Berlin. City transport is a short walk away and the apartment is spacious, high ceilings and has everything you need. The style was lovely. We enjoyed our stay!

My stay at Jan's place was effortless! There were no doubts or issues from check in to check out, which is such a relieve when traveling. The place itself is honestly one of my favorite Airbnbs yet, super cozy attic loft which i found to be quite roomy with tons of natural light from the skylights. Exactly as described and very well kept. Jan was polite, prompt replies, quite clear with instructions and offered everything you may need to feel at home. 10/10 recommend to anyone.

Very clean, very tidy and a lot of free stuff like a beer and crisps.
Thanks for the good stay and see u soon again!

Spot on location, literally a stone’s throw from the underground opening up the whole of Berlin more or less. Place was spotless but I think the floor in our room needed  a better vacuum otherwise all ideal for a few days stay. Staff nice and friendly.

Vincent's house is located close to Görlitzer Bahnof station. So convenient, and in a very lively neighbourhood. If you are seeking a quiet neighbourhood, this is not be the area for you.
The communication before and during my stay was excellent, almost always got an immediate reply. Vincent is an interesting and nice guy, an excellent host. His house is nice and warm, the rooms are spacious and clean. You can use the well-equipped kitchen and bathroom.
Saskia is a really nice and open person, I felt right at home in her beautiful apartment! Would love to stay again.

This was a wonderful place to stay. Ulrike and Ralph were so kind and helpful. The room is clean, comfortable, and beautiful. The location is amazing — walkable to plenty of hip bars, restaurants, bookstores, as well as historic sites. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet and felt safe. I loved staying here and would absolutely stay again next time I’m in Berlin.

A very welcoming host that leaves very clear instructions on how to find and get into the house. Also gave many recommendations for places to eat nearby as well as transport links.
Location wise it is perfect: close to the centre (Alexanderplatz and the museum island) but still a very peaceful area with lots of nice coffee shops and places to eat nearby.
Nice apartment which was clean, and had all the essentials. General living space is limited as was space to cook and store food, but this is all clearly visible from photos so as expected. It is also worth noting there is limited natural light.
For the price and the location you can’t ask for much more, and would recommend for people who just need a base to sleep and explore the city from

Great stay! Was able to do laundry and clean place to stay. Please be aware the rooms are not soundproof and everything echos up and down the building, especially if you are in the rooms by the stairs. The Bob team was great and checked in daily to see if I needed anything. The texts were also entertaining!
Lovis place was absolutely beautiful and a perfect location in walking distance from the park and lots of amazing restaurants.

Had a great stay at Elisa’s. Great location - walking distance to major stations, lots of restaurants around. Once you are inside the place, you can’t hear any noise coming from the streets, which was great. Place is big enough for two travellers. Clean and tidy all around!
Stella’s flat was easy to find and check in, and was clean and comfortable. The location is well connected in a nice area, and would recommend to anyone wanting to explore Berlin
The place is well located off public transport, Douglas was very responsible and flexible with us. It’s right off the street so it can be noisy but hard to beat the location.

Nice new Place. All equipment new. Great towels. Top bed perfect, sleeping on the sleeping sofa okay. The road outside pretty busy, the park
Behind amazing, bus stop right there!

He was a very understanding and good host. The house was beautiful as in the photo, only a little expensive. Still, I recommend it to everyone.
Thanks Berat

An absolute gem in Berlin - this space is beautiful, making it the perfect place to pause, explore, and soak in the atmosphere of the city. Every detail feels thoughtfully designed, and it offers a sense of calm and charm that makes you want to linger. I couldn’t recommend it more highly, and I’ll definitely be returning on future visits to Berlin!

Aryan’s suite is small and cute and in a fantastic location. There were some minor issues but Aryan was quick to respond and find solutions. It’s a quiet suite given how bustling the neighbourhood is. I'd happily stay here again.
We had a great stay. The flat is beautifully decorated and spacious. Great contact with the hosts. Not far from shops and metro. We would come back again!

Good apartment next to Wedding S-Bahn/U-Bahn station, so it's quite easy to get around the city. There is a small kitchenette, but I wouldn't say it's that suitable for cooking, as you don't have any ventilation and only small stove etc. But they do provide the essentials and having some olive oil and salt etc. is always great. The bed was a bit too soft for my liking, but overall everything is as described and it's a good place to stay for couple days.
For us this was the perfect location. It was nice to have a balcony with trees as a view.  It is a very well equipped if small flat.
